title: Everyday merchant payment on an established account
summary: An ordinary retail purchase at a merchant the customer uses regularly, for a typical amount, in the afternoon.
signals: this receiver has been paid before
the amount is in line with what this receiver normally collects
the receiving account already held a balance
lesson: An established receiver plus a typical amount is the clearest possible approve. These cases exist in the knowledge base so the retriever can recognise normality, not only danger.
